BRCA1 is associated with familial cancer of breast, familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1, pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4, and Fanconi anemia complementation group S.⁠1–4 Found 4 disease records for BRCA1: Familial cancer of breast, Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1, Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4 and Fanconi anemia complementation group S.⁠1–4

GENE FUNCTION AND DNA REPAIR

BRCA1 encodes a 190 kD nuclear phosphoprotein that acts as a tumor suppressor and maintains genomic stability.⁠23 Its protein product participates in transcription, double-strand break repair, and recombination.⁠23

VARIANT AND CLINICAL EVIDENCE

Mutations in BRCA1 account for approximately 40% of inherited breast cancers and more than 80% of inherited breast and ovarian cancers.⁠23
